acceptance_criteria: Positive: every artifact is indexed with a run-relative safe path, media/schema version, byte size, content hash and role, and re-verifies on read.

Negative: a traversal segment, a symlink escaping the run root, an unsafe artifact name, a missing artifact and a byte-mutated artifact are each rejected or reported with a stable structured diagnostic, and no write outside the run root ever occurs.
File and symlink checks are performed on the confined path rather than on caller-supplied text.
applicability: Phase 2 Argus Lite bounded software allocation (bounded run evidence persistence, X-COM observation projection import and read-only reconstruction). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction, runtime evidence, scientific validity, or external delivery acceptance.
statement: Argus shall keep every written artifact inside the explicit run root, reject path traversal, escaping symlinks and unsafe artifact names, verify that an indexed artifact is a regular confined file, and detect a missing artifact or a mutated artifact by comparing its recorded size and content hash.
title: Confined artifacts, safe run-relative paths and integrity verification
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the ARGUS2-UNIT, ARGUS2-STATIC, ARGUS2-INTEGRATION and ARGUS2-VALIDATION measures defined in the ARGUS2 verification-design stage, including the real accepted XDL compiler output, the owned C++ X-COM observation-record producer fixture, the offline built-and-installed wheel and the read-only reader. No runtime, live, availability, compatibility, parity or readiness claim is made.
